chunks: And it was narrated from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Nahdī, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked, while I was present, about a woman entering ihram wearing an ʿimāmah with an ʿalam. He said: "There is no harm."

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the one giving the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman about whom the legal question is being asked
key_terms.تُحْرِمُ: enters the state of ihram for pilgrimage rites
key_terms.عَلَمٌ: an emblem, marking, or decorative feature on the garment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a woman to enter ihram wearing an ʿimāmah with an ʿalam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a woman may wear in the state of ihram. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that there is no harm in a woman entering ihram while wearing an ʿimāmah that has an ʿalam.
